summary: Frontend-only validation of new Trade Alerts feature on TradePulse Scanner. All acceptance criteria pass. Alerts dropdown lists 'Off' + all 14 thresholds (50..2000). Selecting a threshold updates the alert-toggle label to '≥ N', displays the alert-count badge, and shows footer-alerts 'N above N'. Rows meeting the threshold get the blue highlight + BellRing alert-flag-<SYMBOL> icon. only-alerts-toggle correctly filters displayTokens (verified: with threshold=2000 on 1d, alert-count=594 and virtualized unique rows=594; toggling off restored the full 671 pairs). mute-toggle clickable without error. alert-off resets label to 'Alerts', removes footer-alerts, clears only-alerts. Regression: timeframe switching (1s/1h/1d), search-input (BTC filter → 5 rows), sort dropdown (sort-change_desc) all work. Table auto-refreshes every ~1s (footer Σ trades value changed between polls).
critical_code_review_comments: Scanner.jsx is 409 lines - approaching split threshold. Consider extracting AlertControls, SortControl, TimeframeBar into small subcomponents for maintainability.
Row highlight uses inline style boxShadow while other styling uses Tailwind - minor inconsistency, not a bug.
seedRef pattern in fetchTokens is subtle - a code comment already exists; fine as-is.

Data curiosity (not part of this task): on 1d timeframe many low-volume tokens show trades=4,001 exactly, hinting at a possible upstream cap in the backend aggregation. Worth a look but out of scope for alerts feature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trade Alerts feature fully validated in iteration_2. All data-testids in review request exist and behave correctly. Virtualized token table uses @tanstack/react-virtual so DOM only renders ~38 rows at a time; to count filtered rows scroll the [data-testid='token-table'] container and collect unique data-testids, OR read the container inner div style.height (rows*34px). Higher thresholds (e.g., 2000 on 1d) make only-alerts filtering discriminating; threshold 100 on 1d matches all 671 pairs so it's not a good filter-check value.
